subject: Clarify: Lounge demo — is 9:00 AM local (SGT) or 9:00 AM home time?
body:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, eng@acme.com
Cc: events@cloudnative.org, concierge@marriott.sg
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Lounge demo — scheduling confirmation (9:00)

Hi all — quick coordination note for the demo during CloudNative Summit:

- Scheduled slot: Nov 30, 09:00 — listed on the invite as "Lounge demo, 09:00".
- Location: Lobby Lounge, Level 1 (Marriott Tang Plaza) — see attached site-plan.pdf.
- Internal crew: Naomi (presenter), Tessa (backup & adaptor kit).

Two things I want to confirm before we lock this: 1) Is the 09:00 referring to local Singapore time (SGT, UTC+8) or to the original US-time reference some external attendees have? A couple of Acme folks are travelling from PST and I want to avoid the usual 12-hour mishap. 2) AV contact at the hotel so Naomi and team can sync on A/V and table power.

Attachment: demo-deck_v3.pdf (18 slides, speaker notes)
Attachment: site-plan.pdf (venue map)

If we confirm 09:00 SGT I'm going to update the calendar invite text to explicitly say "09:00 SGT (Singapore local time)" and add Jules' AV contact to the invite.

Thanks —
Marcus
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

-----Original Message-----
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>; Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>; eng@acme.com
Cc: concierge@marriott.sg; events@cloudnative.org
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Lounge demo — scheduling confirmation (9:00)

Marcus — quick flag. I'm currently in London but flying to Singapore tonight; my calendar is showing the slot as 09:00 in my home timezone (GMT) which will auto-convert to the device's local time once I land. The hotel concierge called the booth staff earlier and said they set lobby clocks to SGT (obviously) but when I checked the meeting room label it said "0930" which made me pause.

So yes: 100% agree we should disambiguate. Can the events team confirm whether the published schedule and the lounge signage use SGT? The Acme engineers are aware of the conference local time but I don't want a bunch of people to show up 8 or 12 hours off because a calendar invite said "9am" with no TZ.

Also: hotel AV — does the Marriott provide a 3.5mm/HDMI breakout or should Tessa bring the adapter bag?

Naomi
Principal Product Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +44 20 5555 9988

-----Original Message-----
From: CloudNative Events <events@cloudnative.org>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>; Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>; eng@acme.com
Cc: concierge@marriott.sg
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:05:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Lounge demo — scheduling confirmation (9:00)

Hi Naomi / Marcus / Tessa / Acme team — thanks for the heads up. Confirming: the schedule published on our site and the on-site signage are in Singapore Time (SGT, UTC+8). The lounge slot on Nov 30 is 09:00 SGT.

Hotel AV contact for the Lounge:
- Name: Jules Tan
- Phone: +65 6123 4455 (whatsapp available)
- Email: jules.tan@marriott.sg (cc'ed to concierge for handoff)

We have a standard HDMI + power run to the lounge demo table. The hotel does not supply adapters for US->Asia plugs or USB-C->HDMI dongles, so please bring any proprietary connectors your kit needs.

Attachment: site-plan.pdf (see booth B4 and Lounge)

We'll add "09:00 SGT (Singapore local time)" to the calendar invite and push a short note to attendees. HubSpot event record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ACME

— CloudNative Events Team

-----Original Message-----
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:46:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Lounge demo — scheduling confirmation (9:00)

I'll pack the adapter bag (HDMI, USB-C->HDMI, EU/UK/US plug adapters). Also bringing a spare laptop for quick failover.

—Tessa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, eng@acme.com
Cc: events@cloudnative.org, concierge@marriott.sg
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Lounge demo — scheduling confirmation (9:00)

Perfect — thanks everyone. Action items before Nov 30: 
- I will update the calendar invite text to say "09:00 SGT (Singapore local time)" and pin the HubSpot event link.
- Naomi: please confirm you have the demo-deck_v3.pdf speaker notes in Drive (link sent).
- Tessa: adapter bag confirmed — we will also bring a cheap HDMI splitter (just in case).
- CloudNative Events: please confirm Jules Tan will be at the lounge 30 minutes before start to help with AV.

Attachment stub: hotel-AV-contact.vcf (Jules Tan)

Thanks — see you in SG.

Marcus
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

"The rest of this thread contains the calendar invite and the attached deck; reaching out to Acme to ensure they have the correct time in their calendar (they confirmed on a call earlier but prefer the explicit SGT text)."
